snippet.title: Terrible Lizards - Official Gameplay Trailer | Xbox @ gamescom 2026
snippet.description:
Terrible Lizards is an upcoming first-person horror parkour game that's set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction called Dalton's Dinos, and we get a new look at gamescom and a release date of October 29, 2026.

Players will need to do all they can to survive this terrifying space that will take players through abandoned dig sites, forgotten caverns, monster-filled tunnels, and more. 

Terrible Lizards will be released on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).

#IGN #Gaming #gamescom
